purpose: Execute a previously admitted on-demand Railway revalidation through an immutable GitHub Actions workflow, GitHub OIDC gate and existing Railway workspace secret without exposing credentials or broadening target scope.
invariants: The workflow cannot obtain scope from the ticket; project/environment/service/source scope comes only from the live admitted execution envelope.
The edge gate validates immutable GitHub OIDC workflow identity and the active Defence attestation authority.
The edge gate rejects expired, terminal, replayed, integrity-failed or fingerprint-drifted execution admissions.
Claiming an execution records the redeploy_started step before Railway mutation.
The Railway workspace token remains a GitHub Actions secret and is never returned to Supabase or logs.
Deployment verification requires terminal SUCCESS and the deployed commit SHA to equal the admitted expectedSourceHeadSha.
Failure before verified deployment records a terminal failed execution event.
The bridge does not change Railway service configuration, variables, domains, replicas, sleep mode or target scope.
The bridge does not perform rollback.
Health, attestation and release reconciliation remain downstream Defence gates and are not implied by a successful Railway deployment.
